flags.expression: AI_FLAG(15)  // AI has an Ace Pokemon. The last Pokemon in the party will not be used until it's the last one remaining.
AI_FLAG(28)  // AI knows player's STAB moves, but nothing else. Restricted version of AI_FLAG_OMNISCIENT.
AI_FLAG(29)  // AI has a chance to know certain non-damaging moves, and also Fake Out and Super Fang. Restricted version of AI_FLAG_OMNISCIENT.
(AI_FLAG_ASSUME_STAB | AI_FLAG_ASSUME_STATUS_MOVES | AI_FLAG_WEIGH_ABILITY_PREDICTION)
AI_FLAG(30)  // AI specific to double battles; AI can deliberately attack its 'partner.'
(AI_FLAG_CHECK_BAD_MOVE | AI_FLAG_TRY_TO_FAINT | AI_FLAG_CHECK_VIABILITY)
AI_FLAG(0)  // AI will avoid using moves that are likely to fail or be ineffective in the current situation.
AI_FLAG(2)  // AI damaging moves and move effects to determine the best available move in the current situation.
AI_FLAG(18)  // AI assumes all moves will low roll damage.

AI_FLAG(20)  // AI has *two* Ace Pokémon. The last two Pokémons in the party won't be used unless they're the last ones remaining. Goes well in battles where the trainer ID equals to twins, couples, etc.
AI_FLAG(7)  // Automatically set for double battles, handles AI behaviour with partner.
AI_FLAG(60)  // Create custom AI functions for specific battles via "setdynamicaifunc" cmd
AI_FLAG(63)
AI_FLAG(3)  // AI will prioritize using setup moves on the first turn at the expensve of all else. AI_FLAG_CHECK_VIABILITY will instead do this when the AI determines it makes sense.
AI_FLAG(8)  // AI will favour certain move effects based on how much remaining HP it and the player's mon have.
AI_FLAG(31)  // AI knows all the species in the player's party, but not moves/items/abilities unless they've been seen.
AI_FLAG(10)  // AI is NOT aware of negating effects like wonder room, mold breaker, etc.
AI_FLAG(16)  // AI has full knowledge of player moves, abilities, hold items.
AI_FLAG(9)  // AI prefers moves that set up field effects or side statuses, even if the user can faint the target.
AI_FLAG(25)  // AI keeps track of the player's switches where the incoming mon is immune to the chosen move
AI_FLAG(24)  // AI will score against the predicting incoming mon if it predicts the player to switch. Requires AI_FLAG_PREDICT_SWITCH
AI_FLAG(26)  // AI will predict the player's move based on what move it would use in the same situation. Recommend using AI_FLAG_OMNISCIENT
AI_FLAG(23)  // AI will predict the player's switches and switchins based on how it would handle the situation. Recommend using AI_FLAG_OMNISCIENT
(AI_FLAG_PREDICT_SWITCH | AI_FLAG_PREDICT_INCOMING_MON | AI_FLAG_PREDICT_MOVE)
AI_FLAG(6)  // AI prefers raising its own stats and setting for / using Baton Pass.
AI_FLAG(22)  // AI adds score to highest damage move regardless of accuracy or secondary effect
AI_FLAG(12)  // AI gets a score bonus for status moves. Should be combined with AI_FLAG_CHECK_BAD_MOVE to prevent using only status moves.
AI_FLAG(33)  // AI will randomize the order of the mons in its party, including the lead. Not an AI flag really, just a way to trigger TPP functionality
AI_FLAG(32)  // AI will randomly choose between eligible switchin candidates of a given category instead of picking the last one in the party.
AI_FLAG(4)  // AI will generally behave more recklessly, prioritizing damage over accuracy, explosions, etc.
AI_FLAG(61)
AI_FLAG(62)
AI_FLAG(19)  // AI switches in mons in exactly party order, and never switches mid-battle.
AI_FLAG(17)  // AI will make smarter decisions when choosing which mon to send out mid-battle and after a KO, which are separate decisions. Automatically included by AI_FLAG_SMART_SWITCHING.
AI_FLAG(14)  // AI includes a lot more switching checks. Automatically includes AI_FLAG_SMART_MON_CHOICES.
AI_FLAG(27)  // AI will make smarter decisions when choosing whether to terrastalize (default is to always tera whenever available).
(AI_FLAG_BASIC_TRAINER | AI_FLAG_OMNISCIENT | AI_FLAG_SMART_SWITCHING | AI_FLAG_SMART_MON_CHOICES | AI_FLAG_PP_STALL_PREVENTION | AI_FLAG_SMART_TERA | AI_FLAG_RANDOMIZE_SWITCHIN)
AI_FLAG(13)  // AI stalls battle and prefers secondary damage/trapping/etc. TODO not finished.
AI_FLAG(5)  // AI adds score bonus to any move the AI has that either OHKOs or 2HKOs the player.
AI_FLAG(1)  // AI will prioritize KOing the player's mon if able.
AI_FLAG(21)  // AI will predict player's ability based on aiRating
AI_FLAG(11)  // AI will use explosion / self destruct / final gambit / etc.

provenance.authorityPolicy: Only facts identified from the hash-pinned Radical Red 4.1 ROM are exact engine semantics. inputs.purpose: All semi-invulnerable, rooted, Smack Down, levitation, Telekinesis, in-air and ability-suppression bits. Every named volatile projection must be lossless to this mask.
Battle Circus applicability. Zero is a value, not a missing-field default.
Circus Magic Room, Gravity and ability-suppression rules. Zero is a value, not a missing-field default.
Gravity is active when nonzero, or when the applicable Circus flag is set.
Magic Room is active when nonzero, or when the applicable Circus flag is set.
A nonzero value suppresses the held-item effect in the exact supported ROM.
The exact hold effect is read from the 44-byte item record after the ROM range check. Identity alone must not bypass Embargo or Magic Room.
The current in-battle ability byte, not species-slot inference or AI belief. It becomes ability 0 when exact ability suppression is active.
Current third-type byte; compared to Flying before type1 and type2.

privateOverrides.behavior: Do not apply the CFRU b637 simulatedRNG[1] < 25 gate; eligible Acupressure reaches its score increase for every candidate sample.
Do not apply CFRU b637's uncommitted Choice-item or Choice-ability early exit.

engineBugs.behavior: The helper writes a switch action and always returns false; without a later successful trigger the dispatcher falls through to a move and loses that switch.
The second-best Choice-lock check reuses the best candidate's party pointer with the second candidate's flags.
Both base-target and spread-partner damage are divided by the base target's maximum HP.
